gui.the_long_travail.catalog.title: Shiyi
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.subtitle: Wherever, whenever, walk with me
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.missing_tra: The Long Travail is not equipped, so effects that require it are inactive.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.sto: Hold %2$s and right-click to reveal the Witness requirements for %1$s, allowing the user to see the required destinations in The Long Travail's diary.
Exploration that meets the requirements still advances progress toward %1$s's Witness before the theme is revealed. Revealing it simply makes those targets visible.
- The Long Travail does not need to be equipped to use a Revelation Stone;
- Each Revelation Stone reveals only its corresponding theme. The six themes must be revealed separately.
One stone is consumed when its theme is first revealed. Using a stone for an already revealed theme does not consume it.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.ess: While wearing The Long Travail, hold %2$s and right-click. Depending on the current state of %1$s in The Long Travail, it helps complete the journey or begins that theme's journey anew.
While wearing The Long Travail with %1$s Malice:
- Randomly completes one incomplete journey record for %1$s, without requiring a visit to the corresponding destination;
- The record may be a biome or a structure and cannot be chosen;
- If it is the last required record, %1$s changes from Malice to Witness.
While wearing The Long Travail with %1$s Witness:
- Resets the completed journey records and Witness for %1$s, and redraws that theme's Witness requirements;
- The journey of %1$s must then be completed again to regain its Witness;
- The new requirements may be the same as before.
An essence only affects its corresponding theme. The requirements, progress, and Witnesses of other themes remain unchanged.

One essence is consumed on successful use. It cannot be used without wearing The Long Travail. If %1$s is still under Malice but no journey records are available to complete, the essence is not consumed.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.di: Damage that bypasses armor and toughness, enchantment protection, Resistance, damage immunity frames, shield blocking, and absorption (yellow hearts).
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.ot: Damage with an attributable source, caused by an entity other than oneself.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.ex:
Attempts to kill the target directly. A successful kill may not follow normal kill processing.
Execution kills have an extremely high processing priority.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.in: When damaged by another source, reduces the damage by the Insight value and retaliates against that source for the same amount.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.cr: When dealing damage, has the corresponding chance to double that damage.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.ov: Negates damage no greater than Overlord multiplied by your maximum health.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.sto: - Revealed themes are recorded by the user and remain revealed after removing, replacing, or refreshing The Long Travail, and after death;
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.in:
Timed separately from vanilla hurt invulnerability frames. Grants immunity to damage while active.
Damage that bypasses invulnerability is unaffected.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.re: While suffering a harmful effect, apply the same effect to its source, with the same level and duration as the effect you suffer.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.ma: Reduces incoming magic-type damage by 10% per level, up to 99%.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.ph: Reduces incoming physical-type damage by 10% per level, up to 99%.
